description: 2MP Full HD Resolution: Delivers crystal-clear 1080P video quality for sharp and detailed surveillance footage, ideal for homes, offices, shops, and warehouses.24x7 Full Color Night Vision: Advanced color night vision technology provides vivid, full-color monitoring day and night, ensuring enhanced visibility even in low-light conditions.Weatherproof Outdoor Design: Durable bullet camera with weather-resistant housing, designed to withstand rain, dust, and harsh outdoor environments for reliable performance.Wide DVR Compatibility: Supports all 2MP and above AHD DVRs, making it an excellent upgrade or replacement CCTV camera for existing security systems.Day/Night Smart Surveillance: Equipped with automatic day and night mode switching for continuous security monitoring, offering dependable protection around the clock.
